english: Fall seven times, rise eight.
One encounter, one chance in a lifetime.
Three years on a stone will warm it — patience pays off.
Even monkeys fall from trees — anyone can make a mistake.
Continuity is power.
Time flies like an arrow.
Never forget your beginner's spirit.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
Fortune comes to a home with a smiling face.
If you're in a hurry, take the long way round.
Seeing once beats hearing a hundred times.
There are mountains, there are valleys — life has its ups and downs.
Dumplings over flowers — substance over appearance.
Ten people, ten colours — to each their own.
Good deeds should be done quickly.
Preparedness averts calamity.
Like attracts like.

japanese: 案ずるより産むが易し
english: Giving birth is easier than worrying about it — fears are often worse than reality.

japanese: 塵も積もれば山となる
english: Even dust, piled up, becomes a mountain.
A three-day monk — someone who gives up quickly.
A sutra in a horse's ear — advice that falls on deaf ears.

japanese: 郷に入っては郷に従え
english: When in the village, follow the village.
The mouth is the source of misfortune.
The strength under the veranda — an unsung hero.
After the rain, the ground hardens — adversity builds strength.
It's darkest under the lighthouse — the obvious is easily overlooked.

japanese: 成功は目的地ではなく旅である
english: Success is a journey, not a destination.

japanese: 無理が通れば道理が引っ込む
english: When the unreasonable prevails, reason retreats.
Kindness is never wasted — it returns to you.

japanese: 急いては事を仕損じる
english: Haste makes waste.
Water takes the shape of its vessel — adapt to your circumstances.
If you do it, it will be done — where there's a will, there's a way.
The moon and a soft-shell turtle — as different as night and day.
Practice makes perfect.

japanese: 終わり良ければ全て良し
english: All's well that ends well.
